caption:
ChatGPT coupon codes checklist: 4 things small businesses and Black-owned businesses should do before Black Friday, now that AI answers hand out promo codes.

On November 20, Search Engine Roundtable reported that Google's AI Overviews and ChatGPT now show coupon codes right inside their answers. In free ChatGPT, each brand gets a card with the code, an end date, a Copy button and a Get deal button. SEO researcher Metehan Yesilyurt found deal cards in about 16% of ChatGPT's Black Friday shopping answers on November 19, up from about 3% four weeks earlier. Black Friday is November 27.

Before Friday:
1. Search "[your business name] coupon code" in ChatGPT and Google and see what comes up.
2. Put your real Black Friday code on one deals page on your own website.
3. Write the discount, the end date and any exclusions in plain text, not only inside a graphic.
4. Take expired codes off your site so nobody finds an old one.

AI can only repeat what it can find. Make sure the first place it finds your deal is your own site.

caption_drafts.explainer:
ChatGPT and Google's AI now show coupon codes inside their answers, and that matters for every small business and Black-owned business running a Black Friday sale.

On November 20, Search Engine Roundtable reported that Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT show promo codes directly in answers. Free ChatGPT shows a card per brand with the code, an end date, a Copy button and a Get deal button. Metehan Yesilyurt found deal cards in about 16% of ChatGPT's Black Friday shopping answers, up from about 3% four weeks earlier.

If your real code lives only in an email or a graphic, AI has nothing official to quote. A clear deals page on your website fixes that.

caption_drafts.provocation:
When a shopper asks ChatGPT for your Black Friday coupon code, does your small business get to decide what it says?

Since November 19, ChatGPT has been showing deal cards with a code, an end date and a Copy button, and Google's AI Overviews show codes too, Search Engine Roundtable reported on November 20. One researcher saw those cards in about 16% of ChatGPT's Black Friday shopping answers, up from about 3% a month earlier.

One Black-owned business has its code on a clear deals page. Another has it buried in an Instagram story. Only one of them gave AI something official to find.
